title: The second set of specifications (Codex): all 28 songs
description: Each song’s new specification against its current one, whole videos, same look and zoom lane within a song. The first five are the ones you reviewed on 17 November; three of them have a “Revised” version made from your notes. The other 23 are in alphabetical order with the reviewing agent’s verdict; its verdicts come from measured data and from watching rides, not from listening.

passages.label: Bones
passages.description: You: “a good specification that follows part of the bgm well, but i feel like a much more ambitious spec would be more suitable”. “Revised” is the more ambitious one written after your note: 24 more chorus words, larger contrasts between sections, stronger closing peaks.

passages.label: Montagem coma
passages.description: You: “a pure banger… only drawback would the passage at around 35-43s that would be better if it was following the voice”. “Revised” follows the voice from 35.3 to 43.1 s; nothing else was changed. Codex notes the drop at the end of that passage measures a little softer than before.

passages.label: Passo bem solto slowed
passages.description: You: “from 6 to 15s it would be great to follow the voice (with relatively low impact, like from 20s to 23s)… 38s to 40s where it should follow the voice”. “Revised” does both; nothing else was changed.

passages.label: Let the world burn
